$comment: Source of the demo/test dataset: recorded bank calls between an agent and a customer. Fully synthetic: invented bank, people, amounts and accounts. Run scripts/generate-audio.ps1 to (re)create the speech clips and the timing manifest the backend seeds from.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Good morning, I am calling from the bank about your personal loan enquiry.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.text: Yes, I would like to borrow fifteen thousand euros for a car.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Before we continue, please confirm your date of birth and your postcode.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Thank you. The loan would run over five years at a fixed rate of six point nine percent.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: I am calling because your loan application is missing two recent payslips.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.text: Can I upload them in the app instead of sending them by post?

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Yes, upload them in the documents section and we will review them within two working days.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: To check affordability I need your monthly income after tax.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.text: It is about three thousand two hundred euros, and my rent is nine hundred.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Do you have any other loans or credit card balances at the moment?

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.text: Only a credit card with around four hundred euros on it.

calls.title: Identity check before discussing the account

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Am I speaking with Mister Max Keller, the main account holder?

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.text: Yes, that is me. My account number ends in four four one seven.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Thank you, Mister Keller. I can now go through the loan offer with you.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Identity verified with two security questions before any account details were shared.

review.comment: Segment 2 is the customer speaking, not the agent. Please fix the speaker.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: You asked about the early repayment fee on your loan.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.text: Yes, if I pay it all back next year, how much extra will that cost me?

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: The fee is one percent of the amount you repay early, and we will confirm it in writing.

calls.title: Joint application call with overlapping speech

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: I have both applicants on the line, so I will ask each of you to confirm the details.

segments.speaker: OTHER
segments.text: Hello, I am the second applicant, can you hear me?

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.text: Yes, yes, we can both hear you fine.
segments.label: CROSSTALK

segments.speaker: OTHER
segments.text: Good. We would like the repayments to come out on the first of each month.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: That works. I will note the first of the month as the payment date.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Call note. The customer asked for a three month repayment holiday after losing a second job.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: I explained that interest keeps building up during the break and the loan term gets longer.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Referred to the financial support team, and a follow-up call is booked for Friday.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Your fixed mortgage rate ends next month, so I am calling with the new options.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.text: What would the two year fixed rate be?

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Four point one percent, and there is no arrangement fee if you switch this month.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Thanks for calling back about the mortgage application you started this morning.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.text: Do you need anything else from me before the valuation?

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Only a copy of your latest bank statement, then we can book the valuation.

scorecards.title: QA: affordability review
scorecards.notes: Income, rent and existing credit were all asked for.

review.comment: The agent did promise written confirmation, so next steps should pass and the outcome is compliant.

scorecards.title: QA: mortgage rate follow-up
scorecards.notes: Rate details given before identity was checked; 'switch this month' deadline is pressure selling.
